confidence_notes: Holistic July estimate. Restaurant anchors are more predictable than lodging, which can rise during summer tour season and around Naadam. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated from their typical several-times-beer relationship; no city-price listings were consulted.
comparable_city_reasoning: Broadly benchmarked against lower-to-mid-cost Central and East Asian capitals such as Bishkek and Almaty, with an allowance for Ulaanbaatar's summer tourism demand.
